lines.meet: I'm Rui, and I'm sorry, I heal people, but please don't ask me how. I'll tell you what it does, and the rest I can't say.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're near the Lashings too, aren't you? I've watched you on the shore. I'm Rui, sorry, I should have said hello before.
lines.ask_home: Sorry, may I ask where you're from? You don't have to say.
lines.ask_work: Sorry, what kept you busy back home? I'm curious, you don't have to say.
lines.answer_home: Peniche, a fishing town on the Portuguese coast. My father fished, and he drowned when I was fourteen.
lines.answer_work: Sardine boats, twenty years, from sixteen. Nights out and mornings in, and mending nets in the evening.
lines.chat_food: Grilled sardines in summer, on bread, by the harbour. Sorry, I know that's simple, but it's the best food there is.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep by the fire, always. In the dark it's louder, and I'd rather not hear it.
lines.chat_missing: The sea at dawn, coming back in with the nets full. Desculpa, I think about it every morning.
lines.chat_here: I took something in my first year when the alternative was dying. I'm sorry, I can't say more than that, and I've never pretended it was a good decision.
lines.tease_quiet: You're as quiet as me, {name}, which I didn't think was possible. Sorry, that's a compliment.
lines.tease_talker: You talk enough for both of us, {name}, which is kind of you, really. I never know what to say.
lines.tease_careful: You check the knots twice, {name}, the way a good fisherman does. Sorry, I notice these things.
lines.tease_bold: You'd go out in any weather, {name}, wouldn't you? The sea doesn't forgive that, sorry.
lines.tease_any: You're kind to me, {name}, and I keep apologising for it. Sorry, I'm doing it again.
lines.tease_back: Ha, sorry, that was good, {name}, and I didn't see it coming.
lines.take_it_kindly: Sorry, {name}, you've got me there. I won't argue.
lines.bristle: I'm sorry, {name}, I can't laugh about that one. Please leave it.
lines.apologise: I'm so sorry, that was unkind. It wasn't what I wanted to say at all.
lines.double_down: I'm sorry, but I meant it. I don't take it back.
lines.needle_quiet: Sorry, but you never say what's wrong, and then it's too late. Please, say something.
lines.needle_talker: Sorry, could you be quieter? It's louder when there's noise, and I can't think.
lines.needle_careful: I'm sorry, but people get hurt while you're still deciding. Please decide faster.
lines.needle_bold: You throw yourself at everything, and then it's me putting you back together. Sorry, but it wears me out.
lines.needle_any: You show off what you can do, and it frightens people. Sorry, but somebody should say it.
lines.bite_back: I've kept you all alive with something I'd give back if I could. Please don't say I don't care.
lines.hurt: Okay, sorry, I'm going to sit by the fire for a while.
lines.laugh_off: Sorry, the fish market men in Peniche said worse every morning, so it's okay.
lines.confide: {name}, I sent money home to my mother and sisters every week for twenty years. I think about the money more than I think about them, and I'm ashamed of that.
lines.listen: Sorry it's been hard, {name}. Take your time, please, I'm listening.
lines.look_out: Stay near me in there, {name}, please, so I can reach you. Sorry, I worry.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, sorry, I'll do as you say.
lines.deflect: Sorry, I'm fine, {name}, please don't worry. The others need you more than I do.
lines.check_in: Sorry, {name}, are you hurt? Please let me see.
lines.blame: I'm sorry, but somebody rushed in, and that's why we fell.
lines.thank: Obrigado, and I'm so sorry I needed bringing back. Thank you, really.
lines.brush_off: Please, it's nothing, don't thank me. Sorry, just rest.
lines.worry: Sorry, {name}, please sit down. I was frightened for you.
lines.handed_down: Sorry, this was yours, wasn't it? I'll mend it if anything tears, I'm good with mending.
lines.hand_fine: Please keep it, I'm sorry it was ever mine. I've got the fire and my father's needle, and that's plenty.
lines.hand_sulk: Sorry, it's fine, only nobody asked first. Really, it's fine.
lines.turn_friendly: I'm glad you're here, {name}. Sorry, I don't say that often, but I mean it.
lines.turn_friends: You're the first person I've wanted to tell everything to, {name}. Sorry, I still can't, but I want to.
lines.turn_grating: I'm sorry, I don't think we get on. I'll sit on the other side of the fire.
lines.turn_rivals: Sorry, but I'll keep healing you, whatever happens between us. It doesn't let me choose.
lines.make_up: I'm sorry, {name}, for all of it. Can we start again, please?
lines.defend: Please, stop, that's not fair. Leave {name} alone, I'm sorry, but leave them.
lines.friend_left: It's very quiet without {name}, sorry, I keep looking up to say something.
lines.friend_back: I'm so glad, {name}, you came back. Sorry, I'm just glad.
lines.common_the_dark: Something offered to help me in the dark, and I said yes. You've done the same, I think, and you know what it costs. I'm sorry for both of us.
lines.common_boats: Twenty years on the sardine boats, nights out and mornings in. People who've worked on the water know the sea can take everything, and I'm sorry, but it does.
lines.common_portuguese: You speak Portuguese! Desculpa, I'm so glad, I've missed it.
